name: Toska Astrea
description: Toska Astrea was the younger brother of the first Sword Saint, Reid Astrea, and the direct ancestor of House Astrea. Living during the era of the Witches four centuries ago, he sought the assistance of the Witch of Greed, Echidna, to repel a Blight Dragon and save his beloved Remina. His child would inherit the Divine Protection to become the second Sword Saint.
